report: Address 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 was examined, but the available evidence is thin. BURST_ACTIVITY: the address executed 12 transactions in a single 30-minute window. That is the only observation in this report: there is no information about its funder, no transaction-pattern comparison with siblings, no statement about how long its history is, and no information about its counterparties or identity. A single signal on its own cannot establish that the address is part of a sybil cluster, and it cannot establish that it is human either.
title: Behaviour evidence report — thin evidence
